name: base64-lite
description: Encodes or decodes Base64 for text and local files, with an optional URL-safe alphabet and data-URI output. Free, runs on your computer, no API key. Install: `pip install git+https://github.com/tidybytetools/base64-lite` · MCP: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/tidybytetools/base64-lite base64-lite mcp`
